_comment: Which numbers take the singular («1 turno», Russian 21) in each shipped language, and for Russian and Ukrainian which take «few» (2, 3, 4) and «many» (0, 5–20); every other number is «other». Read by tests/i18n-plural.test.mjs (Intl.PluralRules through static/platform/i18n.mjs) and tests/test_i18n_plural.py (app/core/i18n.py plural_category), so the two halves cannot drift.
